items.briefing:
Australian organisations using home or business battery storage systems should be aware that these devices are now being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern, meaning they may need to meet new security standards if connected to networks. Separately, scammers continue to target Australians — check Scamwatch regularly for current alerts relevant to your area or industry.

If your organisation uses AI tools, ensure staff only enter work-related information through approved platforms, and avoid sharing sensitive student or organisational data with personal AI accounts. **Practical tip:** Review what AI tools your team is currently using and confirm they're approved by your IT team.
